title: A Benchmark of Absolute and Relative Positioning Solutions in GNSS Denied Environments
authors: H. Yao; X. Liang; R. Chen; X. Wang; H. Qi; L. Chen; Y. Wang
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
